correctness.rationale: For each ordinary support partition there are exactly 2^d overlinings, so modulo 16 contributions vanish at d>=3. The one-size all-one partition contributes 4 and each two-size support {1,m!=3} contributes 8; the m=3 case is divisible by 16. Exact divisor-pair parity converts the total to floor sqrt(n-1) minus (n-1) minus floor((n-1)/3). Jacobi triple product yields the Pbar modulo 8 square/twice-square coefficient classification and F differs by 4. Independently enumerated every ordinary partition for n<=23 and compared two formal coefficient constructions through n=1024.
